summary: Full backend+frontend testing of AWS Infra Inventory & Terraform Portal. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests passed covering instance CRUD, CSV import (verified 5 hosts, 54 DNS, 4 SRV), stats and Terraform HCL+JSON generation (68 resources, valid JSON). Frontend: Dashboard, Inventory (CSV upload, search, add, delete with confirm), DNS & SRV (both tabs with correct counts 54/4), and Terraform Generator (resource checkboxes, generate, HCL/JSON tabs, copy, download) all working correctly. No blocking issues.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); consider lifespan handler
CSV import does not validate/limit file size or content type – could be abused with huge uploads
delete_all_instances endpoint (DELETE /api/instances) has no confirmation/safeguard – destructive on shared internal tool
terraform_generator._hcl_val doesn't escape special characters in string values (quotes/backslashes) which could break HCL for malicious/edge inputs
seed_data_creation: Imported /tmp/datatest.csv via UI (5 hosts, 54 DNS, 4 SRV). One extra manual TEST_manual_add instance was created and deleted during frontend testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py wipes DB in autouse session fixture. Run with `pytest -n 0` (pytest.ini forces xdist workers which caused cross-worker races; -n 0 runs sequentially). CSV at /tmp/datatest.csv.
